reviewer.notes: Cross-vendor re-derivation from live probe files under command-center/p2-wave/probes/RES-0141/, not from the harvest UNIT-COMPLETE badge. CLOUD-OK-REFUTE was correct that harvest sidecars were absent and that the prior Node verifier trusted producer selected_signals. This pass froze 100 labels before writing detector.py, ran 255-candidate Python selection, and a Node verifier that independently enumerates the same 255 combinations, agrees on the locked OR rule, and rejects a suboptimal semver-only lock. Negative control silent; removal-verb mutant red on 4/20. Global unit_manifest.py --write was not run.

defects.summary: Purposive case-control sampling enriches positives; full-corpus precision is not an ecosystem-prevalence estimate.
Labels were assigned by one analyst before implementation but have not received independent adjudication.
Closed: Node verifier now implements all eight eligible signals, enumerates 255 OR subsets on development only, agrees with the producer lock, and rejects a suboptimal semver-only lock.

retry.policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt

residual_unknowns.claim: Whether these point estimates generalize to the ecosystem's natural breaking-change base rate.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Pre-register and double-label a probability sample of at least 500 releases, preserving per-ecosystem prevalence, then evaluate the locked rule once.
Have a blinded second analyst label all notes under the frozen policy and report Cohen's kappa plus adjudicated metrics.

report.question_or_target: Which lexical and structural signals in changelogs actually predict a breaking change, and what precision/recall does the best combination achieve on 100 hand-labelled real release notes?
report.answer: On this 100-note purposive sample, a confirmed semver-major transition (precision 1.000, recall 0.512) and a literal BREAKING CHANGE footer (1.000/0.209) were the most precise individual cues. Raw removal verbs were noisy (precision 0.585, FPR 0.386). Python and Node independently selected the OR of semver_major_bump, drop_support, incompatibility_action on the development split (F1 0.905); that rule scored precision 1.000 / recall 0.628 on all 100 and 1.000/0.400 on the untouched holdout, with false-positive rate 0 on the 20-note negative control. Holdout recall 0.40 shows many labelled breaks lack those three high-precision cues.

sampling.design: Purposive stratified case-control sample across ten dependency projects; apparent precision is conditional on this enriched sample and is not an ecosystem prevalence estimate.

label_policy.positive: The note states that an existing stable/public API, CLI, runtime floor, default, output format, configuration contract, or supported behavior changed such that an existing consumer may need code/config/environment changes.
label_policy.negative: Additions, fixes restoring documented behavior, deprecation warnings that retain behavior, documentation/build/test/internal-only changes, future plans, and explicitly unstable-only changes are negative.
label_policy.review_method: The analyst read each complete extracted release section before recording the decision and rationale in freeze_labels.py.

detector.objective: maximize development F1; ties: precision, recall, fewer signals, lexical tuple

limitations: The purposive 43/57 case-control mix is not the ecosystem's natural prevalence, so precision is sample-conditional.
One analyst supplied labels; no inter-rater agreement is available.
Holdout recall 0.40: many labelled breaks are behavioral/API changes that never use a major bump, drop-support phrase, or incompatibility token.
GitHub release notes are editable; each fetched snapshot is fixed by timestamp and SHA-256 but later text may differ.

extensions.title: Detect breaking changes from release-note prose across the dependency ecosystem
extensions.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim; labelled set committed with labels assigned BEFORE the detector is written; precision and recall computed
tests_required_verbatim: detector control: include 20 release notes with no breaking change and require the detector to stay silent on them; report false-positive rate alongside recall
